facts.text: Full-time undergraduates must complete both weekly chapel attendance and 120 service credits as a requirement for graduation.

sources.title: Spiritual Life Requirements - Azusa Pacific University
sources.quote: All full-time undergraduate students with 12 units or more in a given semester, have a chapel and service requirement.

sources.title: Spiritual Life Requirements - Azusa Pacific University
sources.quote: A full-time undergraduate student's participation in service opportunities satisfies the graduation requirement for service credits, which is as follows, and can be calculated as 15 per full-time semester: 120 service credits for students beginning a fall semester as freshmen
